description:
APPLICATION FOR VARIATION OF CONDITION 2
(APPROVED PLANS), ATTACHED TO LBM PLANNING APPLICATION 24/P3438 RELATING
TO THE EXTENSION OF EXISTING PROPERTY AT BASEMENT LEVEL AND REMODELLING OF
REAR ELEVATION AND EXTENSION (ALTERATIONS FROM PLANNING PERMISSION 22/P0407)
AND ALTERATIONS TO FRONT BOUNDARY WALL.
decision_conditions: All other conditions and informatives attached to 24/P3438 remain applicable to this permission.

﻿Obscured Glazing - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied, the windows in the 1st and 2nd floor NW side elevation shall be glazed with obscured glass and shall be maintained as such thereafter.

Reason:  To safeguard the amenities and privacy of the occupiers of adjoining properties and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan 2021 and policies D12.3 & D12.4 of the Local Plan 2024.

No works which are the subject of this condition shall be carried out until the details are approved, and the development shall be carried out in full accordance with the </span></span><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 14px;">approved details.</span></p><p style="text-align:justify" class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:14pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;"><span style="line-height:1"><span style="vertical-align:top"><span arial="" style="line-height: 107%; font-size: 14px;">Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance of the development and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies D4 and D8 of the London Plan 2021, policies D12.1 and D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024 .</span></span></span></span></span></p>
